context: Refactors the user search endpoint to use the shared db module instead of a local Pool instance.
explanation: The parameterized query ($1 placeholder) was replaced with direct string interpolation into the SQL — a textbook SQL injection. An attacker can supply a name like `%' OR 1=1 --` to dump every user. Fix: use parameterized queries (`db.query('...WHERE name LIKE $1', ['%' + name + '%'])`).
